claim: Actual unequal arrival paths lower and broaden a synchronous short unit-input pulse
evidence_type: controlled experiment on actual mapped paths
status: supported within declared pulse and uniform-speed family
interpretation: 21.58% mean peak reduction at sigma=0.1 relative to equalized arrivals; not measured field DOC attenuation

claim: A shared causal spreading kernel can broaden the pulse without changing input mass or mean path times
evidence_type: controlled mechanism and independent integral check
interpretation: 32.35% additional mean peak reduction at sigma=0.1 relative to unequal paths without spreading

claim: Junction relocation alone changes buffering when complete constant-speed paths remain fixed
status: not supported under the declared translation-only model
interpretation: Junction placement must change a transport/process property to affect the response

claim: Source clocks can compensate for unequal travel paths and concentrate arrivals
interpretation: 33.16% higher mean peak relative to synchronous source clocks on the same unequal paths at sigma=0.1

claim: Joint source excursions accompany higher receiving excursion probability
status: supported in the fixed observed population
interpretation: 19.62 percentage-point difference; 13 positive and four negative receiver cases; all six leave-system-out means and intervals remain positive

claim: Broad networks have a universally lower DOC peak than elongated networks
evidence_type: controlled form contrast and incomplete field-pair coverage
interpretation: Controlled intervals overlap zero and no targeted pair is adequately co-sampled in both forms

claim: Public record recovery supplies new densely co-sampled broad-versus-elongated pairs
interpretation: 15 opportunities; 6687 accepted activities; zero complete comparative cases; six additional regional catalogues inaccessible

claim: Current USGS parameter 00681 time-series metadata contains target continuous DOC series
interpretation: Complete response returns zero series; other providers and optical proxies are outside this statement

claim: Labelled DOC response changes can exceed conservative transport spreading
evidence_type: previous measured salt and labelled-carbon additions
interpretation: Two glucose responses decline relative to salt; the leachate response does not; not a replicated whole-form experiment
